title: L2 — Pipeline Observability & Debug
description: L2 deep-debug dashboard. Select a pipeline to view all runs. Click a Trace ID to load the full span waterfall, phase breakdown, root cause analysis, DQ events, SLO correlation, and streaming metrics. Navigate from L1 via product drill-down links.

list.name: portfolio
list.label: Portfolio
list.description: Data product portfolio — passed from L1 for context. Not used to filter pipeline metrics.

list.name: product
list.label: Data Product
list.description: Data product name — passed from L1. Used to correlate SLO/SLI metrics in the lower section.

list.name: pipeline_id
list.label: Pipeline
list.description: Select a pipeline to see its runs. Pre-populated when navigating from L1 via ?var-pipeline_id=...

list.name: trace_id
list.label: Trace ID (Run)
list.description: Auto-populated when you click a run row in the table. You can also paste a Trace ID directly.

options.content:
### [← Data Marketplace](/d/marketplace-home?var-environment=${environment})  ›  [L1 Estate Health](/d/watch-l1-estate?var-environment=${environment}&var-portfolio=${portfolio}&var-product=${product})  ›  **L2 Pipeline Debug**  |  [L3 Infrastructure →](/d/watch-l3-infra?var-environment=${environment})

**Context:** Portfolio `${portfolio}`  ·  Product `${product}`  ·  Domain `${domain}`  ·  Pipeline `${pipeline_id}`  ·  Owner `${owner}`  ·  Env `${environment}`

**How to use:** Select a **Pipeline** → click any **Trace ID** in the runs table → trace waterfall, phase breakdown, root cause, and DQ events all populate automatically.

panels.title: Success Rate (24h)
panels.description: 24h success rate for selected pipeline(s).

panels.title: Total Runs (24h)
panels.description: Total pipeline runs in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Failures (24h)
panels.description: Failed runs in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Last Run Duration
panels.description: Duration of the most recent completed run.

panels.title: SLA Breaches (24h)
panels.description: Runs that breached SLA (approximated by failure count).

panels.title: Failure Rate Trend
panels.description: 6h rolling failure rate. Rising trend = degrading pipeline reliability.

panels.title: Run Success / Failure Rate — 30m window
panels.description: Run throughput rate. Failures spike on intermittent or systematic issues.

panels.title: Pipeline Duration — Last Observed
panels.description: Last observed run duration per pipeline. Sustained growth = performance regression or data volume increase.

panels.title: PIPELINE RUNS — Click any Trace ID to drill into that run
Pipeline Runs — Click Trace ID to load trace detail
panels.description: All runs for the selected pipeline(s), queried live from Tempo. Click a **Trace ID** to populate the waterfall, phase breakdown, root cause, and DQ panels below. Failed runs shown in red.

targets.query: {span.pipeline.id=~"$pipeline_id" && span.deployment.environment="$environment" && name="pipeline.run"} | select(span.pipeline.name, span.pipeline.id, span.pipeline.status, span.pipeline.type, span.pipeline.failure_phase)

options.content: > **Selected run:** `${trace_id}`   Click a **Trace ID** in the table above to load the waterfall, phase breakdown, root cause, and DQ events. Panels show “No data” until a trace is selected.

panels.title: Span Waterfall — Extract → Transform → Load
panels.description: Full trace waterfall for the selected run. Each span shows stage name, duration, and status. Red spans = failed stage. Click any span bar to see all attributes: row counts, transform operations, source/target systems, error message.

panels.title: Phase Spans — Duration & Status
panels.description: One row per ETL phase (extract, transform, load). Duration in ms. ERROR status = this phase caused the failure. Check pipeline.failure_reason on the failed span.

panels.title: Root Cause Summary
panels.description: Shows spans with ERROR status for the selected trace. pipeline.failure_reason gives the exact error. pipeline.failure_phase identifies the stage. If empty, all spans completed successfully.

panels.title: DATA QUALITY EVENTS — For Selected Run
DQ Events — Extract Phase
panels.description: DQ check events emitted on the etl.extract span. Shows rule name, severity, and affected records. Empty = no DQ events recorded for this run.

panels.title: SLO Compliance
panels.description: Rolling SLO compliance for the associated data product. Breach = pipeline is contributing to SLO miss.

panels.title: Health Score
panels.description: Composite health score for the data product (availability 35%, latency 25%, freshness 25%, error rate 15%).

panels.title: Error Rate
panels.description: Current error rate for the data product. >2% = warning, >10% = critical.

panels.title: Data Freshness
panels.description: Seconds since last successful data refresh. High value = stale data reaching consumers.

panels.title: Error Budget %
panels.description: Percentage of 1% error budget remaining. 0% = budget fully exhausted, pipeline must not introduce further failures.

panels.title: Consumer Lag — Per Topic
panels.description: Kafka consumer lag per topic. Sustained high lag = processing bottleneck or consumer slowdown. Spike = backpressure event.

panels.title: Throughput — Messages / sec
panels.description: Message processing throughput per topic. Drop in throughput with rising lag = consumer health issue.

panels.title: End-to-End Latency — ms
panels.description: End-to-end processing latency from produce to consume. Correlates with SLO latency SLI on the data product.

panels.title: Pipeline Logs — Filtered by Pipeline & Trace
panels.description: Loki logs for the selected pipeline. When a trace_id is selected, logs are further filtered to that run. Currently empty: log shipping to Loki not yet configured in the simulator. This panel is ready for production log integration.
